recognize_zh: 左側為大片淡粉紅、細空泡狀的壞死物質，右側為朝壞死區呈放射狀排列的上皮樣組織球，外緣接纖維組織；壞死與柵欄狀組織球的交界是辨認壞死性肉芽腫的重點。
features: Large area of pale, finely vacuolated necrotic material with scant nuclear debris
Palisading epithelioid histiocytes with oval to elongated nuclei at the interface
Collagenous fibrous tissue with scattered lymphocytes at the periphery
No giant cells, organisms or atypical cells visible
describe_en: Intermediate-power H&E shows a broad area of pale, finely vacuolated necrotic material with scant nuclear debris, bordered by a zone of epithelioid histiocytes with oval to elongated nuclei arranged radially toward the necrosis. Collagenous fibrous tissue with scattered lymphocytes lies at the periphery. No multinucleated giant cells, atypical cells or organisms are identified on H&E. Findings are consistent with a necrotizing granuloma, as seen in cat scratch disease; special stains and microbiologic studies are needed to exclude mycobacterial and fungal infection.

ddx.vs: Caseating granulomas often have Langhans giant cells and acid-fast organisms, without neutrophilic centers.
GMS or PAS stains reveal yeasts or hyphae within the necrosis or histiocytes.
Kikuchi shows abundant karyorrhexis with crescentic histiocytes and no palisading granuloma or neutrophils.
